C08-M10-L01-F1.title: From hunt trigger to testable hypothesis
C08-M10-L01-F1.caption: Refuting evidence and a feasibility check come before any data is examined, and every hypothesis ends in one of three outcomes.
C08-M10-L01-F1.alt: A top-to-bottom flow of seven steps. A hunt trigger becomes a behavior statement, then gains an entity and time scope, then a list of observable predictions tied to sources. Next comes writing refuting evidence before looking at data, then a feasibility check on whether the needed sources exist. The final step shows three possible outcomes: positive, benign, or no-data, where no-data follows when required sources are missing.

steps.label: Predictions
steps.sub: Two or more, each tied to a source
